claim: Package delay for several days, no delivery date : r/UPS - Reddit
summary: I have a small but very important package (UPS Ground) shipping from NYC to California. The package was scanned into the sorting facility on Friday, with estimated delivery of next Wednesday. A few hours later it says delayed and delivery date would be updated as soon as possible. No updates over the weekend and now it’s Tuesday. Called customer and they said the package is in Manhattan ...
